name: Gegera no Joshikou Indoka Keikaku! Part. 1
original_name: げげらの女子高印度化計画！Part.1
source:
An all-girl school introduces co-education due to diminished number of students. Main character is one of the lucky newcomers. He gets a cold welcome by three girls clenching fists and one even holding a baseball bat. But when there's a will, there's a way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所女子学校因学生人数减少而引入男女同校制度。主人公是幸运的新生之一。迎接他的却是三名握紧拳头的女孩，其中一人甚至拿着棒球棒。可只要有决心，就一定有办法。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
